home.mission_desc: CCEABT federates more than <1>60 organizations</1> sharing a common vision: Work for the effectiveness of the right to water, hygiene and sanitation for all, while ensuring sustainable protection of water resources.
home.action_axes_subtitle: Four pillars to transform access to water, hygiene and sanitation in Togo
home.axis_1_desc: Defending the right to water, hygiene and sanitation for all.
home.axis_2_desc: Protecting the resource, modernizing infrastructure and encouraging responsible management.

home.axis_4_desc: Training local stakeholders on water point management.

home.news_art_1_t: Launch of new rural water access program
home.news_art_1_e: CCEABT launches ambitious initiative to improve drinking water access in 50 Togolese villages.
home.news_art_2_e: Over 100 WASH sector stakeholders gathered to discuss sustainable sanitation strategies.
home.news_art_3_e: CCEABT mobilizes civil society to raise awareness about the importance of water resource preservation.

home.cta_title: Ready to make a difference together?

home.about_comp_desc: The Consultation Council for Water and Basic Sanitation in Togo (CCEABT) is the national network of civil society organizations working in the Water, Hygiene and Sanitation (WASH) sector in Togo.
home.values_cit_d: Promote citizen participation for equitable access to essential services.
home.values_dur_d: Guarantee lasting solutions that respect the environment.
home.values_eng_d: Working tirelessly to achieve the sustainable development goals.
home.values_con_d: Promote dialogue and collaboration between all actors.
home.actions_comp_desc: Discover our projects and initiatives to improve access to water, hygiene and sanitation in Togo.
home.proj_1_d: Installation of drinking water points in rural areas to improve access to water.
home.proj_2_d: Awareness of good hygiene practices in schools and communities.
home.proj_3_d: Construction of sustainable and environment-friendly latrines.
home.proj_4_d: Influencing public policies for better access to WASH services.
home.proj_5_d: Implementation of drinking water networks in isolated villages.
home.proj_6_d: Capacity building of water management committees.
home.members_desc: CCEABT brings together a dynamic network of organizations and collaborates with strategic partners.

organization.ag_desc: Composed of all effectives members, it defines the general policy, adopts the statutes and elects the members of the Board of Directors. It is the democratic heart of the network.

organization.se_desc: The permanent body responsible for the daily implementation of activities, project management and network animation.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy

privacy_policy.section_1_li_3: Partner portal (Technical reports, Google Drive links)
privacy_policy.section_2_text: Your information is used exclusively to:
privacy_policy.section_2_li_2: Process your request to join the CCEABT network
privacy_policy.section_2_li_3: Monitor and compile WASH indicators for national advocacy
privacy_policy.section_2_note: CCEABT undertakes never to sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.
